messages:
hannah: quick heads-up: ran into 2s cold-starts on encrypted safetensors bundles. root cause seems to be wallet-like KMS calls during full bundle decrypt + many tiny shard reads. thinking about a manifest-first staged hydration flow

diego: manifest-first? like split bundle into tiny signed manifest + big payload blobs and decrypt the manifest quickly?

hannah: yup. manifest would include bundle_id, shard_table (id, role, byte-range), signer_keyv, priority_hint, and checksum root. small, cacheable, verified. runtime uses that to schedule a minimal ready set

wei: sounds similar to prefix hydration but for encrypted bundles. important ops constraints: KMS quotas and small-file seek costs. propose manifest LRU keyed by (bundle_id,keyv) + host semaphore to gate payload decrypts

diego: agree. also add 'role' tags per shard (kv|base|embed|quant_delta). scheduling rule: warm kv shards first for short-context requests, base+kv for normal, and quant deltas lazy-applied

hannah: API idea: WeightSource options get manifest_first:true, min_ready_roles:["kv","base"], and events: on_manifest_ready, on_shard_ready(shard_id). keep default backward-compatible

wei: security note: only trust priority_hint when manifest signature verifies against our registry or customer-supplied signer. unsigned manifests -> conservative ordering. manifest cache must store signer_key_version and TTL + webhook invalidation path

diego: fallback flow? if top-N shards fail checksum/404, try replica, then re-download full payload, and finally fall back to a smaller pinned model variant if policy allows

hannah: also consider quant overlay as multi-pass hydration: expose partial-model state (base weights) so inference can start, then apply int8/int4 deltas when ready and emit on_precision_upgrade event for tracing/evals

wei: memory budgeting: loader should enforce mem_budget and never materialize more shards than safe. queue lower-priority shards and use eviction hints. add metrics for mem_pressure and queued_shards

diego: ops placement: default per-host sidecar decryptor to minimize latency. provide a central decryptor option inside customer VPC for Private deployments to reduce KMS calls and consolidate HSM usage

hannah: throttling: host-level token-bucket for shard warmups + global per-tenant parallel_decrypt limit. prevents storms when many bundles arrive at once

wei: observability: add manifest_decrypt_ms, manifest_verify_ms, time_to_first_shard_ms, time_to_min_ready_ms, kms_calls_per_min, concurrent_payload_decrypts. instrument p50/p95/p99

diego: potential abuse vector: malicious bundle with hints to force IO/mem pressure. mitigation: verify signer, rate-limit warmups, and enforce scheduling cost model so hint can't bypass quotas

hannah: rollout plan: 1) RFC sketch manifest envelope + sidecar proto 2) spike (2 engs) implement sidecar RPC + loader hooks 3) bench with synthetic bundle shapes 4) opt-in beta and metrics review 5) decide mandatory vs opt-in for encrypted bundles

ops-bot: ticket INF-5012 created for "manifest-first staged hydration + sidecar decryptor" (owner: hannah, reviewers: diego, wei)

wei: timeline: can we prototype next sprint? i'll pick up loader hooks, diego can do sidecar, hannah drafts RFC tonight

diego: one more perf caveat: measure KMS p95 not just mean. p95 KMS latency kills cold-start UX

hannah: yep will add p50/p95/p99 for both manifest decrypt and full ready time. thanks all :thumbsup:
